repos.name: 05_Audiobook_Generation
repos.summary: Audiobook Generation System converts long documents (EPUB/PDF/TXT/Markdown) into mastered audiobooks with chaptering, text normalization, neural TTS synthesis, and agentic pipeline orchestration. It includes a trainable text-normalization model, neural TTS backend (SpeechT5), and deterministic agent for document processing.

repos.name: 3D_Software_and_Python
repos.summary: The repository provides example Python scripts for Autodesk 3D Studio Max, Maya, and Blender that demonstrate how to use the Python API to create similar scenes across these applications. It includes functions for preparing scenes, importing and animating meshes, creating geometry from vertex data, handling hierarchies and animations, and assigning materials. All scripts come with simple GUIs and are designed to show basic usage of Python in 3D software.

repos.name: 9router
repos.summary: 9Router is an AI router that connects coding tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, and others to 40+ AI providers and 100+ models, enabling unlimited free AI coding with auto-fallback and token savings. It provides a dashboard for managing providers and supports multiple CLI tools through a single endpoint.

repos.name: A2A
repos.summary: Agent2Agent (A2A) is an open protocol enabling communication and interoperability between opaque agentic applications. It allows AI agents built on diverse frameworks to discover each other's capabilities, negotiate interaction modalities, and securely collaborate on complex tasks without exposing internal state or tools. The protocol supports standardized JSON-RPC 2.0 over HTTP(S) with flexible interaction methods including synchronous request/response, streaming (SSE), and asynchronous push notifications.

repos.name: a2a-inspector
repos.summary: The A2A Inspector is a web-based tool that allows developers to inspect, debug, and validate servers implementing the A2A (Agent2Agent) protocol. It provides a user-friendly interface to connect to A2A agents, view agent cards, perform specification compliance checks, and monitor communication via live chat and a debug console.

repos.name: a2a-js
repos.summary: The A2A JavaScript SDK provides a TypeScript/JavaScript implementation of the Agent2Agent (A2A) Protocol specification v1.0.0, enabling developers to build A2A servers that expose agent capabilities over multiple transports and A2A clients that discover and interact with those agents. It supports three wire transports (JSON-RPC, HTTP+JSON/REST, gRPC), includes backward compatibility with v0.3 peers, and provides tools for streaming tasks, task cancellation, and push notifications.

repos.name: a2a-python
repos.summary: The A2A Python SDK provides a library for building and running agentic applications that comply with the Agent2Agent (A2A) Protocol, enabling communication between agents using multiple transport methods including JSON-RPC, HTTP/REST, and gRPC. It supports asynchronous operations and offers optional integrations with databases, web frameworks like FastAPI, and observability tools such as OpenTelemetry.

repos.name: aar-loop
repos.summary: The repository implements a manual Reflexion loop based on the US Army's 4-question After Action Review (AAR) method to help AI agents learn from sessions and avoid repeating mistakes. It guides users through reviewing sessions, identifying issues, writing concrete lessons, and applying fixes to skills or rules files. The system compiles lessons into a persistent LESSONS.md file that can be loaded by future sessions.

repos.name: aauto-sdk-1
repos.summary: An unofficial Android Auto SDK that provides access to Android Auto's projection, service, and notification capabilities, along with sensor data and vendor channel communication for car-specific protocols. It enables developers to create Android Auto applications that can interact with vehicle systems and hardware.

repos.name: academic-research-skills
repos.summary: Academic Research Skills provides a suite of Claude Code skills for managing the complete academic research pipeline from initial research through final publication, including literature review, writing assistance, citation management, and peer review support. It offers tools for planning paper structure via Socratic dialogue, conducting literature reviews, generating academic content, and performing quality checks on references and claims. The system emphasizes human-in-the-loop collaboration to avoid AI-generated research pitfalls while automating routine tasks.

repos.name: activepieces
repos.summary: Activepieces is an open source workflow automation platform that serves as a replacement for Zapier, enabling users to create AI-powered workflows and integrations with over 200 services. It provides a type-safe pieces framework in TypeScript that supports AI agents, MCP servers, and AI workflow automation with support for Claude Desktop, Cursor, and Windsurf.

repos.name: adk-docs
repos.summary: Agent Development Kit (ADK) is an open-source, code-first toolkit for building, evaluating, and deploying sophisticated AI agents with flexibility and control. It provides a modular framework optimized for Gemini and the Google ecosystem but is model-agnostic and deployment-agnostic. The toolkit supports rich tool ecosystems, code-first development, modular multi-agent systems, tracing and monitoring, and seamless deployment across various platforms.

repos.name: adk-go
repos.summary: An open-source, code-first Go toolkit for building, evaluating, and deploying sophisticated AI agents with flexibility and control. It provides a modular framework for creating AI agents that can be orchestrated and deployed in cloud-native environments.

repos.name: adk-java

repos.name: adk-js

repos.name: adk-kotlin

repos.name: adk-python
repos.summary: An open-source, code-first Python toolkit for building, evaluating, and deploying sophisticated AI agents with flexibility and control. It provides a graph-based execution engine for composing deterministic agent workflows, structured task delegation, modular multi-agent systems, and rich tool integration capabilities.

repos.name: adk-samples
repos.summary: A collection of sample agents built with the Agent Development Kit (ADK) that demonstrate how to solve real problems using ADK patterns. It includes canonical recipes curated by the agents-cli team and community-contributed recipes for specific use cases or workflows.

repos.name: adk_cloud_run

It includes a multi-tool agent implementation ready to be run locally or deployed via gcloud CLI. repos.name: adrflow
repos.summary: ADRFlow is an MCP server that captures architectural decisions made while coding, automatically detecting and recording them during AI-assisted development. It allows users to search, filter, and export these decisions for documentation and future reference. The tool integrates with AI coding assistants like Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, and Codex to provide context-aware decision logging.

repos.name: af-deep-research

It returns structured research packages with entities, relationships, evidence, and cited documents.

repos.name: AFFiNE
repos.summary: AFFiNE is a next-gen knowledge base that combines planning, sorting, and creating in one platform. It offers a merged canvas for docs, whiteboards, and databases with real-time collaboration and local-first data ownership. The platform supports multimodal AI integration and provides tools for creative organization and knowledge management.

repos.name: afx-nuke-plugins

The plugins offer enhanced functionality and performance compared to Nuke's native tools, with some utilizing CUDA and Intel IPP for accelerated processing.

repos.name: agency-agents
repos.summary: A collection of specialized AI agent personalities designed for specific workflows in software engineering, design, paid media, and sales domains. Each agent provides expert-level capabilities with defined processes, deliverables, and communication styles tailored to particular tasks.

repos.name: agency-swarm
repos.summary: Agency Swarm is a framework for building multi-agent applications that leverages the OpenAI Agents SDK to create, orchestrate, and manage collaborative swarms of AI agents with customizable roles, tools, and communication flows.

repos.name: agent-beacon

It provides local-first storage with optional forwarding to SIEM and log aggregation tools.

repos.name: agent-desktop

repos.name: agent-framework

repos.name: agent-kernel

repos.name: agent-lightning

repos.name: agent-os

repos.name: agent-search
